name: Wavelet-based genetic association analysis

prior: Scale-specific Bernoulli association probabilities pi_s; coefficient priors inherited from Servin-Stephens, with full parameters deferred to the unavailable supplement
inference_algorithm: Analytic coefficient Bayes factors; EM fitting of pi; maximum statistic over nearby SNPs; permutation calibration; low-count filtering and quantile/PC adjustment for tests
estimand: Regional association statistic and permutation p-value; original-domain effect profile with pointwise posterior means and variances
data_input: Matched individual-level sequencing profiles and SNP genotypes
tunable_settings: Region length B (power of two); nearby-SNP range; low-count cutoff L (2 in the analysis); number of permutations and sequential stopping rule; PCs removed (4 in the analysis); wavelet basis (Haar here)
